description.content: Use this REST API to retrieve license legal metadata in raw or HTML format.

Use this REST API to retrieve the raw license legal data for components in an application.

Permissions required: Review Legal Obligations For Components Licenses

variable.description: (Required) Enter the application id or public id.

response.name:
The response contains a list of all components in the application and the corresponding license legal metadata. For each component, the response includes component data and license legal metadata. 1. The component data includes:
  • `packageURL` is the package URL or pURL of the component.
  • `hash` is the truncated hash value and can be used in other REST API calls. It should not be used as a checksum.
  • `componentIdentifier` includes the component format and its coordinates.
  • `displayName` is the display name of the component.
  • `licenseLegalData` contains the legal data.
  • `stageScans` is a list and each element contains `stageName` at which the application was scanned, the `scanId` of the application scan, and the `scanDate`.
2. The `licenseLegalMetaData` is used as a dictionary for legal data and for each license contains the license id(s), name, license text, obligations, license threat group, and whether or not it is multi license.
